2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Giants face stiff test against Cowboys in Harbaugh's debut
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: The Giants' explosives-based offense, led by coach John Harbaugh, faces a Dallas defense that excels at preventing big plays.
